description: Merkle roots and inclusion proofs only (SIGE spec 8.1); consistency proofs are a separate, later category (see the report). leafHash(leaf)=SHA256(0x00||leaf), nodeHash(l,r)=SHA256(0x01||l||r). 7 leaves (a non-power-of-2 size, exercising the carried-forward odd node). verifyInclusion(leaf, index, treeSize, proof, root) must accept both pinned proofs and reject a wrong leaf. Signed tree heads are out of scope here: TransparencyLog generates its signing key internally with no way to fix it, so no signature is pinned. Independently cross-checked: the full root via a from-scratch recursive tree over node:crypto sha256, structurally different from merkle.ts's iterative pairwise collapse. The recursive tree splits at the largest power of two below n (RFC 9162's MTH definition), confirmed equal to merkle.ts's algorithm for every leaf count from 1 to 32; a naive ceil(n/2) split is a different, wrong rule that only coincides with this one at n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 15, 16, ... (powers of two and one less than a power of two).

vectors.description: 7 leaves, inclusion proofs for the first and last index
